title: Design System: hafizhfadh.id — Warm Technical Editorial

display.purpose: Hero headline only — two lines, final word italic terracotta.

headline.purpose: Section H2s; the contact invitation scales up to clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 4rem).

title.purpose: Chapter and item titles in Instrument Serif; smaller serif roles at 1.4–1.7rem.

body.purpose: Manrope running text — lead 1.125rem, standard 1.0625rem, compact 0.9375rem, small 0.875rem; 36–62ch measure.

label.purpose: Lowercase IBM Plex Mono micro-labels at 0.75rem — sage-deep on ivory, ivory/60 on navy.

data.purpose: Dates, metrics, stack lists, attributions, diagram annotations — mono is a measurement instrument, never a voice.

shadows.name: button-ambient
shadows.purpose: Warm clay-tinted lift under the primary button; hover deepens to rgba(154,62,35,0.6) at 0 12px 32px -14px.

shadows.name: form-panel-float
shadows.purpose: The cream contact form panel floating over the navy invitation section.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal rise and fade (0.7s) — the system's default editorial easing.

motion.name: ease-draw
motion.purpose: Hero schematic stroke draw-in (1.4s) — the page's one authored load animation.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Button, chip, input, and link state transitions.

motion.name: duration-underline
motion.purpose: Nav-link underline growth; wordmark period scale.

motion.name: reveal-rise
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal offset; JS-applied only (content visible without JS), IntersectionObserver threshold 0.12 with −48px bottom margin, one-shot.

motion.name: pulse-soft
motion.purpose: The only ambient loop: terracotta diagram pulse dots (opacity 1→0.55, scale 1→1.25).

motion.name: spin-slow
motion.purpose: Hero dashed terracotta ring rotation — three turns, once, then at rest.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion clamp — the reveal action never hides content.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The page's only raised colored element — a warm clay pill carrying the most important action per view.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Let's talk about your engineering challenges</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-clay, #b04a2c); color: var(--color-ivory, #f4efe5); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', sans-serif); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 14px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(40,44,43,0.10), 0 10px 28px -14px rgba(176,74,44,0.55); transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-claydark, #9a3e23); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(40,44,43,0.10), 0 12px 32px -14px rgba(154,62,35,0.6); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-clay, #b04a2c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent pill with a sand border, quiet until hovered.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-charcoal, #282c2b); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-sanddeep, #d6c5ab); border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-cream, #faf8f2); border-color: rgba(40,44,43,0.4); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-clay, #b04a2c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Handwritten-note input inside the cream form panel — ivory ground, sand border, clay focus and caret.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-charcoal, #282c2b); } .ds-field-req { color: var(--color-clay, #b04a2c); } .ds-field-input { margin-top: 8px; width: 100%; background: var(--color-ivory, #f4efe5); color: var(--color-charcoal, #282c2b); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', sans-serif); font-size: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-sanddeep, #d6c5ab); border-radius: 8px; caret-color: var(--color-clay, #b04a2c); transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: rgba(92,90,82,0.9); } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: rgba(40,44,43,0.4); } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-clay, #b04a2c); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-clay, #b04a2c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-chips-legend { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: lowercase; color: var(--color-sagedeep, #55645b); } .ds-chips-row { margin-top: 12px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-sanddeep, #d6c5ab); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-inkmuted, #5c5a52); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(40,44,43,0.4); color: var(--color-charcoal, #282c2b); } .ds-chip-selected { background: var(--color-navy, #172b40); border-color: var(--color-navy, #172b40); color: var(--color-ivory, #f4efe5); } .ds-chip:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--color-clay, #b04a2c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }

components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; background: rgba(250,248,242,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(229,216,196,0.8); } .ds-nav-inner { max-width: 1152px; margin: 0 auto; height: 64px; padding: 0 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-nav-wordmark { font-family: var(--font-serif, Georgia, serif); font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1; color: var(--color-charcoal, #282c2b); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-dot { color: var(--color-terracotta, #c85a3a); display: inline-block; transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-wordmark:hover .ds-nav-dot { transform: scale(1.25); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 28px; } .ds-nav-links a { position: relative; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-inkmuted, #5c5a52); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-links a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 1px; width: 0; background: var(--color-clay, #b04a2c); transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--color-charcoal, #282c2b); } .ds-nav-links a:hover::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: var(--color-clay, #b04a2c); color: var(--color-ivory, #f4efe5); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(40,44,43,0.10), 0 10px 28px -14px rgba(176,74,44,0.55); transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: var(--color-claydark, #9a3e23); } .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-clay, #b04a2c); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-nav-links { display: none; } }

components.css: .ds-ledger { background: var(--color-navy, #172b40); color: var(--color-ivory, #f4efe5); padding: 40px 32px; } .ds-ledger-row { max-width: 1152px; margin: 0 auto; border-top: 1px solid rgba(244,239,229,0.15); padding: 40px 0; display: grid; gap: 20px; align-items: baseline; } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-ledger-row { grid-template-columns: 4fr 5fr 3fr; gap: 40px; } } .ds-ledger-figure { font-family: var(--font-serif, Georgia, serif); font-size: clamp(3.4rem, 6.5vw, 5.75rem); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-claylight, #e09b77); } .ds-ledger-claim { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', sans-serif); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.375; color: var(--color-ivory, #f4efe5); } .ds-ledger-context { margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', sans-serif); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--color-fog, #c3cfd9); } .ds-ledger-details { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--color-fog, #c3cfd9); } .ds-ledger-meta { margin: 16px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace); font-size: 12px; color: rgba(244,239,229,0.6); }

components.name: Authored Figure
components.description: Signature component — hand-drawn sage line-art with an italic mono print caption; diagrams are always authored, never stock.
components.css: .ds-figure { max-width: 320px; margin: 0; } .ds-figure svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; } .ds-figure-caption { margin-top: 8px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace); font-size: 10.5px; font-style: italic; color: var(--color-inkmuted, #5c5a52); } .ds-figure-pulse { animation: ds-pulse-soft 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; } @keyframes ds-pulse-soft { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.55; transform: scale(1.25); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-figure-pulse { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview: A personal letter from a senior engineer, set like a fine engineering annual report — warmth carrying authority. The whole site is warm ivory paper: type-led compositions ruled with sand hairlines, deep navy sections anchoring the proof and the invitation, and one family of fired-earth accents that lets the page speak (terracotta) and act (clay). Density is low and confidence is high; every claim is set in a measured serif and every number in a working mono. The system deliberately refuses two references. The first is the old world — a dark obsidian telemetry dashboard with emerald accents — now the anti-reference: no dark grounds outside the three navy anchors, no neon, no glow, no classification tags, no dashboard chrome. The second is the generic cream-and-serif consultancy template: this system earns its editorial character through a complete structure — navy anchor sections, sand hairlines instead of cards, sage technical linework, true bylines and pull-quotes, italic-mono figure captions, and terracotta so rare it always means something. Each of the nine sections is its own composition inside one system: an asymmetric hero with an authored systems schematic, an editorial letter with a pull-quote, alternating service chapters with diagrams, a navy ledger of verified numbers, a ruled timeline, a glyph field guide, a mono toolkit index, a sticky-split process, and a navy invitation holding a cream form panel.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory canvas (#f4efe5) with cream panels (#faf8f2); structure drawn as 1px sand hairlines (#e5d8c4), never boxed cards
Three full-bleed deep-navy anchors (#172b40) per page: impact ledger, contact invitation, footer
Terracotta (#c85a3a) for display emphasis; clay (#b04a2c) for everything interactive
Editorial serif display (Instrument Serif) with italic terracotta emphasis; Manrope body; IBM Plex Mono strictly for data, dates, and technical annotations
Sage (#687c70) authored SVG line-art with italic mono figure captions ("fig. 01 — …")
One authored motion moment — the hero schematic draws in; scroll reveals are gentle, JS-applied, and reduced-motion safe
Pill buttons; soft 8–16px corners only where content is contained; focus rings in clay (clay-light on navy)

rules.name: The Terracotta Speaks, Clay Acts Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is display-only emphasis — type, nodes, punctuation. Every interactive state is clay or clay-dark. Terracotta is never a surface you can click; clay is never a headline color.

rules.name: The Three Navy Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Deep navy appears exactly three times per page as full-bleed anchors — the impact ledger, the contact invitation, the footer. Never as cards, panels, or sidebars on ivory.

rules.name: The Warm Ink Rule
rules.body: Ink is warm charcoal on warm paper — never pure black, never cool gray. On navy, text is fog or ivory, and muted levels are made with opacity (ivory/60, ivory/15), not by inventing new grays.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif ships one weight — 400 — plus italics. Hierarchy is size, tracking, and italics; never bold the serif and never fake a heavier display weight.

rules.name: The Mono Is a Measurement Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono appears only as data, dates, metrics, stack lists, attributions, lowercase micro-labels, and figure captions. Never for headlines, never for running prose, never uppercase.

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: Only the primary button and the contact form panel cast shadows. Everything else is flat: if a surface needs separating, use a sand hairline or change the ground — never add a shadow.

rules.name: The Hairline Structure Rule
rules.body: If it separates, it's a 1px sand rule. If it contains, it may round (8px fields, 16px panels). If it's pressed, it's a pill. Nothing else gets a border.

dos: Do draw structure with 1px sand hairlines (#e5d8c4) — divide-y chapters, border-t rows, border-y section frames — instead of reaching for a card.
Do keep IBM Plex Mono strictly for data: dates, metrics, "·"-joined stack lists, attributions, lowercase micro-labels, and figure captions.
Do set emphasis in serif italic, and spend terracotta (#c85a3a) only where the page speaks loudest — the hero's final word, the wordmark's period, diagram pulse nodes.
Do make every interactive element clay (#b04a2c) with a 2px clay focus ring (clay-light #e09b77 on navy).
Do author diagrams as sage line art (1–1.5px strokes, round caps) with italic mono captions ("fig. NN — …").
Do hold body copy to a 36–62ch measure and let whitespace — 80/112px section padding — do the separating.
Do respect reduced motion: reveals never hide content, animations clamp to ~0ms, and the page must be fully readable with JavaScript off.
donts: Don't box content: no card grids, no repetitive card rows, no nested cards — compose with hairline-ruled rows and asymmetric 12-col splits.
Don't resurrect the old dark dashboard: no obsidian grounds, emerald telemetry accents, neon glows, gradient text, or SERVICE // 01-style classification tags.
Don't set headlines or prose in mono, and never uppercase the mono labels — they stay lowercase.
Don't add eyebrow kickers above headlines.
Don't use navy as a component fill (the selected radio chip is the one exception) or shrink it into boxes and sidebars — navy is full-bleed only, and only three times per page.
Don't introduce a second authored load animation; the hero draw-in is the page's one motion moment (diagram pulse dots are the only loop).
Don't bold Instrument Serif or fake a heavier display weight.
